text: The Building Better Communities and Conserving Watersheds Act, 2017 (Bill 139) received Royal Assent on December 12, 2017 and has been proclaimed into law as of April 3, 2018. Bill 139 makes substantial changes to the planning system in the Province and will have significant impacts on procedures, processes and resources at the City. This report sets out those impacts and recommends the funding of resources required to implement Bill 139.

City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1.
